integral.tolerance_rationale: f=2 over a unit square: the integrand is constant, so the quadrature is exact up to binary64 roundoff (order 1e-16 relative); 1e-9 leaves about seven orders of margin.

average.tolerance_rationale: integral/measure for a constant field is 2 exactly; same roundoff-only allowance as the integral.

std.tolerance_rationale: a constant field has zero variance; the tolerance is an absolute one because the expected value is zero.

rms.tolerance_rationale: sqrt(measure-weighted mean of f^2) with f=2 is again exact up to roundoff.

denominator.tolerance_rationale: the reported denominator must be the domain measure V=3, not the element count; both are integers here, so the check is exact.

denominator.tolerance_rationale: the unit square has measure 1, but the field f=x+2y is defined on the y in [0,3] strip, so the reference area is 6; planar measure integration is exact up to roundoff.

integral.tolerance_rationale: integral of x+2y over the strip is 24 analytically; the integrand is degree 1, so COMSOL's quadrature is exact up to binary64 roundoff and 1e-9 leaves ~7 orders of margin.

average.tolerance_rationale: 24/6 = 4 exactly; the tolerance covers division roundoff only.

std.tolerance_rationale: sqrt(10/3) comes from the analytic variance of x+2y over the strip; a square root adds at most a few ulp, so the same roundoff-only allowance applies.

rms.tolerance_rationale: sqrt(58/3) from the analytic second moment; same roundoff allowance as the std.

revolved_volume.tolerance_rationale: pi*r^2*h = 12*pi measures a revolved solid, so the volume comes from curved-boundary quadrature over a triangulated surface rather than an exact planar formula; 1e-6 is about four orders above the observed deviation and is the same allowance the axisymmetric measure has always used here.

average_r.tolerance_rationale: the volume-weighted mean radius of a solid cylinder is 4/3; it inherits the revolved-measure allowance.

cross_section_measure.tolerance_rationale: the revolved 2-D cross-section measure must be 6 as well; same curved-quadrature allowance.
